name: zc_dusk_handover
status: voided: readings missing or disagreeing with themselves

tests.name: both moon-caster knobs exist in the RUNNING build, by sentinel round-trip

detail.note: a CVar that does not exist reads 0.0, which is exactly the shipped default of both

tests.name: the camera sees open ground, that ground is open to the sky, and no character is standing in the patch
every arm and hour produced a reading
every reading agrees with itself on the ground luma the verdict is computed from

detail.note: ground is the measurement and is gated; the frame rect is the settle monitor and is reported. H_SETTLED below fails if frame instability is widespread

tests.name: the scene is settling -- frame instability is isolated, not general

detail.note: one transient is a pond or a leaf; a tenth of the ladder is a world that never came to rest, and then no reading in it can be trusted
